headline: Asian shares cautious amid AI selloff fears while Tata Steel approves ₹28,000 crore asset sale

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Asian shares opened cautiously as fears of an AI market selloff persist despite a rebound in US futures.
Tata Steel approved the sale of its tubes & pipes business and Tata Steel Colors for ₹28,000 crore.
Core sector performance remains under observation by market participants.
Investors are evaluating buy, sell, or hold recommendations across key midcap and legacy names.
whatHappening: Tata Steel agreed to sell its tubes & pipes unit and Tata Steel Colors to Apollo Tubes for ₹28,000 crore.
Food regulator allowed prosecution against Bisleri for allegedly unsafe water.
Waaree Energies, Berger Paints, Blue Dart Express, Raymond, and Indian Bank were named as stocks to watch today.
Paypal announced Claire Bramlee as the new Chief Financial Officer succeeding Jamie Miller.
summary: Indian stock market opens today amidst cautious global cues triggered by persistent AI sector selloff concerns. Major corporate announcements include Tata Steel selling its tubes and pipes business to Apollo Tubes for ₹28,000 crore. Traders are keeping a close eye on stock-specific actions involving Waaree Energies, Berger Paints, and Indian Bank.
